title: Dolphin wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='dolphGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#5fd0ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2f8fd6'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bellyGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#d8f4ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#9fd8f0'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points='40,26 62,26 51,4' fill='#ff4fa0'/>
  <polygon points='40,26 62,26 51,4' fill='none' stroke='#ffd23f' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='4' r='4' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <line x1='44' y1='23' x2='58' y2='23' stroke='#4fe3b8' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <line x1='46' y1='16' x2='56' y2='16' stroke='#ffd23f' stroke-width='2.5'/>

  <!-- tail fin -->
  <polygon points='30,68 12,52 14,78' fill='#3fa9e0'/>
  <polygon points='30,68 12,52 16,64' fill='#6cc8f5'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <path d='M28,66 C34,48 52,42 68,46 C80,50 84,62 80,72 C74,86 52,90 40,84 C32,80 26,76 28,66 Z' fill='url(#dolphGrad)'/>

  <!-- belly -->
  <path d='M38,74 C46,80 64,80 76,72 C70,84 50,88 40,84 C36,82 36,78 38,74 Z' fill='url(#bellyGrad)'/>

  <!-- dorsal fin -->
  <path d='M54,44 C56,34 64,32 68,38 C64,42 60,44 56,46 Z' fill='#2f8fd6'/>
  <path d='M56,43 C58,37 63,36 66,39 C63,42 60,43 57,45 Z' fill='#6cc8f5'/>

  <!-- pectoral fin -->
  <path d='M48,72 C44,80 40,86 34,88 C36,80 40,74 44,70 Z' fill='#2f8fd6'/>

  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='58' r='5' fill='#0b3a5e'/>
  <circle cx='69.5' cy='56.5' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M74,66 C78,68 82,68 84,65' fill='none' stroke='#0b3a5e' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
